responsibility: This grammar/action source defines mc parser pass 4, focused on constant-expression construction and related declaration-time expression semantics. Using the declaration and stack utilities, it parses and builds expression trees for literals, operators, set values, function calls, and attached comments where needed, resets and consumes saved constant-expression worklists per module, and completes the compile-time expression information required before code-body parsing in pass 5.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated implementation grammar for pass 4: it contains the full BNF and semantic actions that parse constant-expression and declaration-time constructs. Unlike mcp4.def, it is not just the public entry-point declaration but the parser body itself.
